slice: fixed-host validation of the round-5 probes: live time trigger success and the first bounded real-model core event-tool round
purpose: Validate the round-5 integration on the fixed host: a live one-shot time rule trigger (append-only side effect), and a bounded real-model single-round core event-tool probe after the first-step/context/title/history fixes. Failures before the successful run are recorded; none was retried after a real model turn was admitted.

zeroModelTimeTrigger.classification: exactly one real time.occurred event was appended to the live control ledger with the canonical identity and reserved probe scope (no live delivery); the rule and time state were removed with no residual; the receipt explicitly discloses the append-only, undeletable event and zero business-table/external effects.

receipt.bytesSemantics: actual committed file bytes (UTF-8); an earlier value was the character count

realModelProbe.classification: the real provider admitted exactly two main requests/streams and one read-only types tool round; the provider reported usage (input 1469, output 41, total 2406 as reported; no cache fields); the final JSON typesSeen matched the tool result types length; title housekeeping was suppressed twice without a provider call; the disposable Session was flushed, released, disposed and archived with cleanup verified; no Goal/Task/budget/Effect/business fact was created.
realModelProbe.note: This is a diagnostic probe outside the Shiyu budget ledger by design, so the provider usage above is not charged to a Shiyu reservation; it is disclosed instead of being mapped to product modelCalls.

reloadGranularity.note: six ordered reloads in round 5 but only four audit snapshots were captured (before, after the first 6ecb487 reload, after the real-model probes, final). Intermediate rebuilds (7f57ea1, 7704e5d, 3bec321, 3e2bbf9) were not audited individually; their reload effects are included in the aggregate deltas and are arithmetically consistent (each reload +6 commitSeq/+1 lifecycle event/+2 capability revision, sessions unchanged by reload).

limitations: This is a bounded diagnostic probe, not a full core decision round, Goal, plan or Task; it does not prove real plan quality, provider cache accounting or business acceptance.
Usage is provider-reported only (cache fields absent); totalTokens 2406 does not equal input+output 1510 and is recorded as reported rather than recomputed.
The live time-trigger probe intentionally appended one undeletable time.occurred event; it is disclosed as a real side effect.
Five pre-pass attempts are disclosed with their root causes; none was retried after a successful admitted model turn.
Real browser DOM, real channels/devices, checkpoint capture readiness and nine-system acceptance remain untested.
